title: Painkiller Cocktail (Classic and Frozen)
description: The very first whiff of fresh‑grated nutmeg over a frothy Painkiller whisks me straight to Jost Van Dyke, where the drink was born in the 1970s. It’s sunshine in a glass: creamy coconut, tangy pineapple, bright orange, and a healthy glug of navy rum. Today we’re bottling that beach‑bar magic at home—no fancy blender required (but I’ll give you a frozen riff, too)
author: Better Sweet Drinks
instructions:
1. Fill a 12‑oz (350 ml) tiki mug or highball with crushed ice. Set aside.
  1. In a cocktail shaker: add rum, pineapple juice, orange juice, and cream of coconut. Fill with cubed ice and shake hard for 10 seconds.
  2. Strain into the prepared glass, crown with a small mound of crushed ice.
  3. Grate fresh nutmeg over the top until fragrant. Add a pineapple wedge and fronds for the full island vibe. Serve with a short straw—this is a sipper.
notes:
• For a frozen version: blend all liquids with 1 cup pebble ice for 5 seconds.
  • Vegan mocktail: replace rum with 2 oz coconut water + 2 dashes bitters.
